reason: Expert explains that transmission nodes temporarily show an unknown module status after a hot swap until the inventory refresh completes.

knowledge.summary: On transmission nodes, a newly hot-swapped line module appears as an unknown module until the inventory refresh completes; wait about 3 minutes before taking action.
knowledge.author: Erkki Expert
knowledge.details: Inventory refresh takes approximately 3 minutes. If still unknown after 5 minutes, reseat once.
